name: Remembering and recalling the person's own knowledge
vision_statement: A request recalls the part of the person's own knowledge its goal needs, from cards that are current with their sources, found by meaning and proportionate in size, and never from anyone else's.
opportunities: The cards a person's work leaves behind are copies of what lives elsewhere, so the store itself raises questions the parent solution does not ask: when a card has drifted from its source file, how an assistant keeps serving the last known listing while a backend is down and replays the writes that failed, how a store is kept proportionate to its sources instead of inflating with copies from a backups folder, which folders a corpus may index at all, and how a card is found by meaning when the person asks in other words. Each has alternatives that can be measured against each other.
solution_coherence: remember-and-recall recalls the cards that match a request through card-store. card-store keeps the cards through persist-cards, serves the last known listing through cache-cards while a backend is down, finds them by meaning through index-by-meaning, labels them through label-context-cards, reports stale ones through detect-stale-cards, holds their growth in check through bound-card-growth and shrinks an inflated store through repair-a-card-store. repair-a-card-store rewrites the stored cards through persist-cards and asks choose-what-to-index which sources deserve cards.
